svg.title: The cost of confirmation
svg.desc: The cost of confirming 64 KiB of guaranteed 15-byte packs, 4 369 packs, as two bars on one scale of 1 px per 160 bytes. Request/response: 4 369 replies of at least 27 bytes each, 117 963 bytes in all. AdHoc: one Confirm_ service pack, the pack id alone, 1 byte with a one-byte id, about 0.002 percent - too thin to see at this scale. The service packs are generated for the project; nothing is declared for them. The packs themselves carry nothing for the guarantee, and a connection without Resumable carries nothing of it; the sender keeps a journal, the newest bytes in memory and the rest in 4 MB files, up to resumable_megabytes, 100 MB by default.

g.text: Confirming 64 KiB of guaranteed 15-byte packs (4 369 packs)

text.tspan: 1 service pack Confirm_: the pack id alone =

g.text: Confirm_ and the other service packs are generated for the project: you declare none of them.
The packs themselves carry nothing for the guarantee; a connection without Resumable carries nothing of it.
The sender keeps a journal: newest bytes in memory, the rest in 4 MB files, up to resumable_megabytes (100 MB by default).
